1. Build the 1D weights r + 1 - |i| for i from -r to r and divide them by (r + 1) squared.
2. Pad each row with the border mode and filter it with these weights.
3. Pad each column of that result and filter it with the same weights.
4. Round to 8 bits. Keep alpha unchanged.
